title: [GMCP 203.046.03] Integration: Property testing, fuzzing, model checking, and continuous red-team
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-046-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: All parsers, serializers, state machines, URI/schema evaluators, policy decisions and transport boundaries have invariant/property tests and coverage-guided fuzz targets with retained regression seeds. Lifecycle, task and subscription models are checked for safety/liveness; threat-model abuse cases map to automated adversarial tests; sanitizer and red-team campaigns report zero unresolved critical/high findings at release. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
